title: Producing Your Own Seedlings in the Nursery
summary: Choosing your nursery technique (cell trays, seed trays, open-field nursery), making rich potting mix, managing shade and fine watering.

pages.title: OPEN FIELD
pages.text:
OFF-GROUND FOLLOWED BY TRANSPLANTING

To produce your seedlings, three techniques are commonly used:

1) Produce seedlings in an open-field nursery.
2) Produce seedlings in an off-ground nursery.
3) Transplant seedlings into pots before final transplantation.

Each method has its advantages and disadvantages. We will show you how to choose based on your needs!

pages.title: 1. THE IN-GROUND NURSERY
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour 1. LA PÉPINIÈRE DE DÉMARRAGE PLEINE TERRE

pages.title: What is an open-field nursery?
pages.text: Seeds are sown directly into prepared soil. Young plants grow there before being transplanted.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Qu’est-ce qu’une pépinière de démarrage pleine terre?

pages.text:
What are the advantages of an in-ground nursery?

- It's simple and quick to set up
- Requires little equipment ✅

✅ 👎 What are the disadvantages?

- Fragile roots during transplanting
- A faster risk of drought
- Susceptibility to soil-borne diseases ❌

❌ ❌

pages.title: 2. THE OFF-GROUND STARTING NURSERY
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour 2. LA PÉPINIÈRE DE DÉMARRAGE HORS SOL

pages.title: What is an Off-Ground Starter Nursery?
pages.text: Seeds are sown in containers before transplanting the seedlings: trays, pots, flats. These containers are filled with potting mix.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Qu’est-ce qu’une pépinière de démarrage hors sol?

pages.title: You will need the following materials:
pages.text:
A quality potting mix
A protective mosquito net
Sand or pebbles for drainage 🪴 🛑 💧
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Vous aurez besoin du matériel suivant :

pages.text:
👎 ++ + 👍 What are the advantages of off-ground nurseries?

* Better root control
* The nursery is easily transportable ✅ ✅ What are the disadvantages?

* More frequent watering
* Requires additional equipment ❌ ❌

pages.title: 3. THE NURSERY FOLLOWED BY TRANSPLANTING
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour 3. LA PÉPINIÈRE SUIVI D’UN REPIQUAGE

pages.title: OR
pages.text:
What is transplanting?

Young plants are first grown in the ground or soilless, then transplanted into pots before final transplanting.

This technique is commonly used for tree nurseries and fruiting vegetables.

pages.title: You will need the following materials:
pages.text:
Pots or plastic bags
Nutrient-rich potting soil 🪴 🌱
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Vous aurez besoin du matériel suivant :

pages.text:
💪 👎 STRESS What are the advantages of transplanting?

- Stronger roots
- Better recovery after transplanting
- Reduced time in the field
- Reduced water requirements ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ What are the disadvantages?

- Additional labor
- Risk of stress if poorly transplanted ❌ ❌
